styles.css: /* wp-ja-restaurant: colours in both modes. The source (JA Restaurant 1.0.6, Joomla 6 T3) has no dark mode; light = tokens.css, measured on the running source (20/10/2026), and every value reads the worn design system first (var(--ds-c-<role>, <the template colour>)) as the 1.0.6 sheets do. Dark is DERIVED (DECISIONS D-03): page #1c1a17, white boxes #26231f, the menu and footer band #11100e, text #e9e4d6, headings #f0ece2, borders #544e46; the accent #d24a24 and the yellow #ffd33d stay. No attribute = auto, the OS decides; assets/js/wp-ja-restaurant-dark.js writes data-theme light|dark from the tracy_theme cookie before the first paint. */ :root{color-scheme:light dark;--jr-yellow:var(--ds-c-accent-hover, #ffd33d);--wp--preset--color--bg:light-dark(var(--ds-c-bg, #f4f2e7),var(--ds-c-bg, #1c1a17));--wp--preset--color--surface:light-dark(var(--ds-c-surface, #ffffff),var(--ds-c-surface, #26231f));--wp--preset--color--surface-warm:light-dark(var(--ds-c-ink, #3a352f),var(--ds-c-ink, #11100e));--wp--preset--color--fg:light-dark(var(--ds-c-fg, #3a352f),var(--ds-c-fg, #e9e4d6));--wp--preset--color--fg-2:light-dark(var(--ds-c-heading, #333333),var(--ds-c-heading, #f0ece2));--wp--preset--color--muted:light-dark(var(--ds-c-muted, #555555),var(--ds-c-muted, #b5ad9e));--wp--preset--color--meta:light-dark(var(--ds-c-meta, #999999),var(--ds-c-meta, #8f877a));--wp--preset--color--border:light-dark(var(--ds-c-border, #cccccc),var(--ds-c-border, #544e46));--wp--preset--color--border-soft:light-dark(var(--ds-c-border-soft, #e5e2d6),var(--ds-c-border-soft, #3a352f));--wp--preset--color--accent:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent, #d24a24),var(--ds-c-accent, #d24a24));--wp--preset--color--accent-on:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-on, #ffffff),var(--ds-c-accent-on, #ffffff));--wp--preset--color--accent-hover:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-hover, #ffd33d),var(--ds-c-accent-hover, #ffd33d));--wp--preset--color--accent-active:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-active, #ffd33d),var(--ds-c-accent-active, #ffd33d));}:root[data-theme="light"]{color-scheme:light}:root[data-theme="dark"]{color-scheme:dark}
